title: Make algorithms click.
text: What if you could see your code think? Meet Teem Treat Visualizer. Find a problem, open its workspace, and follow every step.

title: Know what to learn next.
text: Start with prerequisites. Explore topics, expand their subtopics, and discover the concepts you need before taking the next step.

title: From concepts to practice.
text: Open a concept guide. Find prerequisites, recommended problems, and the visual features that bring each idea to life.

title: Follow the data. Follow the code.
text: Watch Two Sum connect an array and a hash map. Pause, step forward, and follow the highlighted code at your own pace.

title: Advanced graphs, made visible.
text: Explore Network Delay Time. Follow the priority queue and watch shortest paths take shape across a weighted network.

title: See recursion unfold.
text: Dive into Brace Expansion Two. Follow recursive calls, inspect the active stack, and see how nested choices combine into results.

title: Choose. Check. Backtrack.
text: Try N Queens. Watch candidate positions and conflict checks, then follow the search as it places a queen or backtracks.

title: Build answers from smaller states.
text: Explore dynamic programming. Watch each state build on earlier results, with the code and visualization moving together.

title: Focus on what matters.
text: Zoom in for detail. Zoom out for context. Hide a panel, restore it, or maximize it to give an important step more space.

title: A workspace that moves with you.
text: Dock or float your playback controls. Rearrange panels and resize the workspace to suit the way you learn.

title: Make it your experiment.
text: Open Code Playground. Run a Python or JavaScript sample, inspect its trace, then change your code and compare the results.

title: Build understanding, one step at a time.
text: Select the lines you want to discuss and attach them to chat. From your first array to your next challenging graph, explore Teem Treat Visualizer.
